headline: Oil Tanker Explodes in Strait of Hormuz as US Forces Attack Iranian Fishing Boats in Gulf Waters
summary: An oil tanker exploded in the Strait of Hormuz as US forces attacked two Iranian fishing boats in Gulf waters, according to the report. The source describes ongoing US-Iran hostilities.
why: The Strait of Hormuz is a key chokepoint for global oil shipments, so attacks there directly affect crude supply and shipping risk.
why_moved: An explosion on an oil tanker in the Strait of Hormuz amid US-Iran hostilities heightens risk to Gulf oil shipments.
